node.statement: Under H, validated node 1.1 applies verbatim: its maximum/minimum construction gives finite universal K_1>=1 and e_call_1>0, proves K_1*e_call_1<=e_1, and bounds epsilon, L*epsilon, (c_0^cb+1)*epsilon, and t_1=K_1*epsilon by all six required thresholds. Thus H implies the asserted conditional ledger.
